channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: USS Roosevelt arrives in Middle East: Is the US-Iran war about to resume?
item.description: The aircraft carrier joins two others operating in the US Central Command area of responsibility.

item.title: Third US aircraft carrier arrives in Middle East amid tensions with Iran
item.description: Trump shares a message saying: ‘May God protect our troops’ as the USS Theodore Roosevelt arrives in the Middle East.

item.title: Why is China resisting a nuclear treaty with the US and Russia?
item.description: Beijing has a smaller arsenal than Washington and Moscow and worries that a pact could limit its nuclear capabilities.

item.title: At least 11 killed in blaze on Thailand’s Phuket island
item.description: Authorities are investigating the cause of the fire, which also injured 16, but have ruled out arson.

item.title: How Russia is preparing Iran for the next escalation
item.description: Russian space intelligence sharing can help Tehran get ready for an imminent US assault.

item.title: Iraqi armed group denies involvement in oil smuggling, calls probe a ‘lie’
item.description: Iran-aligned Kataib Hezbollah says the group is subjected to 'blackmail' to force disarmament amid US pressure on Iraq.

item.title: Yemeni forces retreat to defend port city from Houthis
item.description: Saudi-backed forces say they are moving troops from the Bab al-Mandab Strait to protect the interim capital, Aden.

item.title: UK and allies call on Israel to allow rapid humanitarian access to Gaza
item.description: The UK, Australia, Canada and Italy say Israeli authorities are holding back vital supplies at the borders, including 150,00 tents.
